description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEducationDao class, which provides data access operations for EmployeeEducation entities within an HRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee education records, utilizing Doctrine ORM features and custom search filters.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmployeeEducation entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and search functionalities within the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeEducation entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeEducation record by employee number and education ID. Returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingEmpEducationIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing EmployeeEducation IDs for a particular employee, filtered by a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEducations
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeEducation records for a specific employee based on provided IDs, returning the number of records deleted.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Performs a search for EmployeeEducation records based on provided search filter parameters, returning a list of records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for EmployeeEducation search results, applying filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationsCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of EmployeeEducation records matching the search filter criteria.
